title: Why delivered costs understate prices in an integrated global hydrogen market
abstract: arXiv:2610.41447v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Delivered-cost estimates are often used as proxies for hydrogen import prices. Yet they measure average supply-chain costs, whereas marginal prices measure the system value of an additional unit. Market interactions can make the two diverge, potentially biasing long-term price assumptions. We quantify this gap using an 81-region global hydrogen-market model, comparing each region's costs and prices when only its demand is active and when all regions' demands are active. The 2045 price-cost gap is positive in 78 regions and averages 63 EUR/MWh (52% of the single-buyer cost) on a demand-weighted basis. Only 12 EUR/MWh reflects higher average sourcing costs due to competing demand. The remaining 51 EUR/MWh is the difference between the global-market price and the delivered portfolio's average cost. In several regions, wholesale prices rise while average delivered costs fall. Hydrogen strategies should distinguish delivered-cost benchmarks

translated_title: 为什么在一体化全球氢能市场中交付成本会低估价格
translated_abstract: 交付成本估算常被用作氢能进口价格的代理指标。然而，它衡量的是平均供应链成本，而边际价格衡量的是新增一单位产品的系统价值。市场相互作用可能使两者产生偏离，从而导致长期价格假设出现偏差。我们利用一个涵盖81个区域的全球氢能市场模型来量化这一差距，比较各区域在仅有自身需求活跃时与所有区域需求均活跃时的成本与价格。在2045年，78个区域的价格-成本差距为正值，按需求加权计算平均为63欧元/兆瓦时（占单一买方成本的52%）。其中仅12欧元/兆瓦时反映了竞争性需求导致的平均采购成本上升，其余51欧元/兆瓦时则是全球市场价格与交付组合平均成本之间的差额。在若干区域，批发价格上涨的同时平均交付成本却在下降。氢能战略应将交付成本基准与市场价格区分开来。
tldr: 该研究利用81区域全球氢能市场模型量化发现，交付成本会系统性低估氢能市场价格，2045年平均低估63欧元/兆瓦时（占单一买方成本的52%），且其中大部分源于市场相互作用导致的边际价格与平均成本之差，而非采购成本上升，因此氢能战略应将交付成本基准与市场价格区分开来。
en_tdlr: Using an 81-region global hydrogen-market model, this study shows that delivered costs understate hydrogen prices by an average of 63 EUR/MWh (52% of single-buyer cost) in 2045, driven mainly by market interactions rather than higher sourcing costs, so hydrogen strategies should distinguish delivered-cost benchmarks from marginal market prices.
